newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates -Quoted at thin flat-lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates -Quoted at thin flat-lower levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted at steady to lower levels in bids and offers on Thursday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Wednesday.
- Five barges, Osceola through Cairo, Mississippi River, bid 95 percent of tariff, unchanged from Wednesday, no offer.
- Four barges, Osceola through Cairo, Mississippi River, one each week of September, bid 135 percent, down five percentage points from Wednesday, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of December, bid 155 percent, down 2-1/2 percentage points from Wednesday, no offer.
